newsitem.title: UK: MTL warns on 96, 97 profits due strong stg.
newsitem.headline: MTL warns on 96, 97 profits due strong stg.

text.p: British industrial instruments maker MTL Instruments said on Thursday that a harsh competitive environment, combined with the strengthening pound, had damaged its export-based orderbook and undermined profit margins.

"Current year profits will therefore be significantly below expectations," the company said in a statement, adding, "If the pound remains at current levels and the extreme competitive pressure continues, profits growth in 1997 will also be affected."
"Actions are being taken to further improve manufacturing efficiency to strengthen the group's competitive position," the firm added.
MTL makes and markets electronic explosion-protected instruments and devices for use in the measurement and control of industrial processes in hazardous environments.
After the profit warning, the company's shares were marked down a massive 47.5 percent by 1500 GMT to be indicated at 157-1/2 pence, down 142-1/2 pence, though no volume was recorded.
